name: Bing Qin
email_source: Printed in the arXiv HTML author block of arXiv:2608.29662v1 (ACTD: Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization): 'Bing Qin (corresponding author) | Affiliation: Harbin Institute of Technology | Affiliation: Peng Cheng Laboratory | Email: qinb@ir.hit.edu.cn'. Independently re-confirmed by arXiv:2607.18955v1, where the only two emails on the page are qinb@ir.hit.edu.cn and xcfeng@ir.hit.edu.cn and the only two corresponding authors are Bing Qin and Xiaocheng Feng, both HIT. ir.hit.edu.cn itself is blocked by the network egress proxy.
evidence: ANCHOR (email): the ACTD author block maps every author to a matching email one-to-one and internally consistently (Huiyi Zhang->hyzhang@, Zijian Li->lizijian@, Weitao Ma->wtma@, Xiaoliang Yang->xlyang@, Yichong Huang->ychuang@, Xiaocheng Feng->xcfeng@, Bing Qin->qinb@), so there is no field-shift artifact in that paper; the organization anchor is HIT plus Bing Qin's standing co-author Xiaocheng Feng, the same pairing as on CultureForest. ANCHOR (ResearchGate): the page is titled "Bing Qin's research works | Harbin Institute of Technology and other places" and its listed topics are multimodal LLMs / NLP, matching the HIT SCIR professor and deputy director of the Research Center for Social Computing and Information Retrieval. NOTE: this is a ResearchGate scientific-contributions stub (auto-generated for an unregistered author), not a claimed /profile/ page - a site:researchgate.net/profile search returned no HIT-affiliated Bing Qin, only namesakes rejected here: Bing QIN at USTC Department of Chemistry (researchgate.net/profile/Bing-Qin-4), Bing QIN at Jinan University Department of Biochemistry (researchgate.net/profile/Bing-Qin-7), plus Libo Qin (different first name, Central South University) - none are the NLP professor. LinkedIn: site:linkedin.com/in "Bing Qin" Harbin returned no matching profile (only Bing Zhang @ HIT Shenzhen and Feng Qin @ HIT, both rejected as different people); no LinkedIn presence, which is normal for a mainland-China-based professor. Also confirmed from arXiv 2606.01879v1: Bing Qin carries superscripts 1 and 3 = Harbin Institute of Technology and The University of Hong Kong.
